hammerd: migrate to generalized MOCK_METHOD() macro This CL replaces the uses of MOCK_METHOD*() and MOCK_CONST_METHOD*() macros in unit tests with the generalized MOCK_METHOD() macro, which is now the recommended way to define mocked methods with gmock. In particular, MOCK_METHOD() supports annotating a mocked method with specifiers such as 'override'. One minor change is that argument names are omitted in the argument list provided to MOCK_METHOD() in order to prevent clang-format from formatting code like `Foo* foo` into `Foo * foo`. BUG=None TEST=Run unit tests. Change-Id: Idcc875376c6c04cc0c9aa6db46f752f13946558f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1817430 Tested-by: Ben Chan <benchan@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Ben Chan <benchan@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Joel Kitching <kitching@chromium.org>
